questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which one of the following statements is correct?

options.content: From a mixed precipitate of AgCl and AgI, ammonia solution dissolves only AgCl
Ferric ions give a deep green precipitate on adding potassium ferrocyanide solution
On boiling a solution having K<sup>+</sup>, Ca<sup>2+</sup> and HCO<sub>3</sub> ions we get a precipitate of K<sub>2</sub>Ca(CO<sub>3</sub>)<sub>2</sub>.
Manganese salts give a violet borax bead test in the reducing flame

questions.explanation:
Between AgCl and AgI, AgI is less soluble, hence ammonia can dissolve ppt. of AgCl only due to formation of complex as given below:

AgCl + 2NH3 [Ag(NH3)2]Cl
